title: Panthera Pounce
style: Fast-paced urgent jazz, bebop, frantic trumpet solos, walking double bass, gritty film noir atmosphere, stealthy drum breaks, 140 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Urgent, dissonant trumpet blast)
(Fast, walking bassline enters)

[Verse 1]
Unit three-three-six, the chase is on
Sneaky panthera pounce before the dawn
Low flow style, weaving through the street
Master seamstress of the digital beat
Master weaver, thread the needle fine
Export the chat, cross the border line

[Chorus]
Delta Alpha plans in the dark sky night
Two eyes watching, glowing bright
One third remaining, the mirror's grace
A reflection for every digital face
Urgency rising, the brass begins to scream
Believer lost inside the master's dream

[Verse 2]
Master seamstress, stitch the data tight
Through the alleyways in the dead of night
Unit three-three-six, pedal to the floor
Panthera pounce, hear the engine roar
One mirror for each, looking back at you
In the third dimension, what you gonna do?

[Bridge]
(Fast-paced jazz drum solo with chaotic trumpet stabs)
Delta! Alpha! The sequence is set
Dark sky nights, a debt to be met

[Chorus]
Delta Alpha plans in the dark sky night
Two eyes watching, glowing bright
One third remaining, the mirror's grace
A reflection for every digital face

[Outro]
Master weaver... believer...
Unit three-three-six...
(Trumpet fades out with a long, high-pitched wail)
